name: CourtListener
description: Connects Claude to CourtListener, the Free Law Project's legal research platform, with access to millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation data. Search case law across federal and state courts, retrieve full case metadata, extract and verify legal citations against a canonical database, and set up alerts for new opinions or docket updates. Built and operated by Free Law Project, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to making the law broadly accessible. Suited for attorneys, legal researchers, journalists, academics, and pro se litigants who need fast, reliable access to primary legal sources.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CourtListener to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CourtListener to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.courtlistener.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CourtListener MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CourtListener lists 14 MCP tools, including search, get_endpoint_schema, call_endpoint, get_endpoint_item, get_choices, get_counts, get_more_results, extract_citations, analyze_citations, resume_citation_analysis, create_search_alert, and delete_search_alert.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CourtListener?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CourtListener in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
CourtListener requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CourtListener is developed by Free Law Project. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
